title: Opening of the interview, date and full name
summary: Hinton opens the March 20, 1979 session, confirms Maxwell's name James Kendrick Maxwell and invites him to start with birth and family.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: This is March 20th, Tuesday night, March 20th, 1979. And I'm sitting here talking to James -- what's your middle name, James?

Is that so? Well, Jim, we just want to rap with you a little bit about some of the things, your good times and your bad times. And what you've done and who you are, from when you came, that sort of thing. So now that we've established the date you just go on and tell us about your birth and your family and whatnot.
